title: Oculiform
summary: OC'ULIFORM, adjective [Latin oculus, eye, and forma, form.] In the form of an eye; resembling the eye in form; as an oculiform pebble.

inlines.v: OC'ULIFORM, adjective [Latin oculus, eye, and forma, form.] In the form of an eye; resembling the eye in form; as an oculiform pebble.
